name: Unnamed fraud group (Milan prosecutors investigating; at least one foreign suspect registered)
brief: Fraudsters posing as Intesa CEO Carlo Messina sent a WhatsApp message asking for urgent help with an overseas transaction, then placed a call using an AI-cloned voice of a trusted lawyer (A&O Shearman Italia partner Paolo Nastasi) to persuade the chairman to authorise transfers of ~€95M, mostly to accounts in China and Hong Kong; much was recovered but ~€36M remains unrecovered (some reports say €39.5M). *Analyst note: the AI-voice detail comes via press reporting of the case file (prosecutors' wording is "reportedly"); the WhatsApp message itself was not AI.* Il Post
